knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A recurring quote is built from its frequency, height, edging, waste, access and written exclusions so that the scope is clear.
Aeration is deferred during drought stress. The client is told why and offered a date that the calendar supports.
A mid-season extra is a variation. It is written, approved and priced before the work starts.

practicalCriteria: Given a supplied mock site visit record, the learner builds a recurring quote that lists frequency, height, edging, waste, access and exclusions within the assessor's set time.
The learner builds a seasonal calendar for a supplied species card that shows at least one deferral period with the reason.
The learner responds to a supplied mid-season request by issuing a written variation with an approval step before the work starts.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Recurring quote for the mock site, reviewed by the assessor.
Seasonal calendar with the deferral period, signed by the assessor.
Variation record for the mid-season request.
stopWorkCriteria: Scheduling a simulated product application without confirmed authority in the mock location.
Starting a simulated extra service before the written variation is approved.
